headline: Capital One (COF) Stock Looks Below Fair Value Despite A 102% Run
summary: Capital One Financial has more than doubled shareholders' money over the past three years, yet its current valuation checks still point to the stock trading at a discount to an internally estimated intrinsic value. With fresh legal headlines in the background, the question for investors is whether that apparent discount is a genuine opportunity or compensation for higher perceived risk.
